chunks: Then will come after that a year in which the people shall be given rain, and in which they shall press (grapes).

key_terms.يُغَاثُ: to be given rain / to receive moisture

ai.seo_question: What happens in the year following the drought in the story of Prophet Joseph?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often interpreted as marking the end of the seven years of famine and the beginning of the 'Year of Abundance' (Am al-Ma's), where Joseph (AS) implemented his economic strategy to secure Egypt's resources. The phrase 'they will press' (ya'sirun) is understood by scholars like Allamah Tabatabai to signify not just agricultural recovery but the full utilization of stored grain and the restoration of economic stability under Joseph's wise governance.
